question: Does an exact all-input weight-only bilinear capability tensor enrich the two heads already selected by held-out causal greedy composition as writers into the shared M11 U8 computation?
evidence_status: Retrospective diagnostic red-team on an independently selected causal writer bank. It tests whether weight capability can shortlist causal writers without activation occupancy; it cannot promote a new edge.

searched: temporal/is-was source writer factorials, weight-ordered greedy results, complete upstream activation-conditioned tensor incidence atlases, and restricted M11 weight tensors
selected-head projector weight-interface rankings and their tolerance audit
all H/R and weight-capability/occupancy records through v20
prior_art.known_result: The immutable six-head bank was ordered independently from causal evidence. Is/was selected L7H7+L9H4; temporal selected those two plus L9H1. Existing tensor-incidence atlases condition on observed base/donor states. No result tests the exact all-input x-plus-Wz polynomial for these frozen writers.
prior_art.novelty: For each frozen head output map W, this test exactly expands M11(x+Wz)-M11(x), read into the causally identified U8, into context-by-write and write-by-write tensors without using an activation row.

frozen_design.selection_independence: Candidates and positives are copied exactly from the earlier weight-ordered greedy result. No new weight score, tensor spectrum, or activation outcome selected them.
frozen_design.tensor: For writer map W and shared read basis U, compute the exact U^T M11 output change under x->x+Wz as C[a,i,k] x_i z_k + S[a,k,l] z_k z_l. C is the context-by-write tensor and S is the write-by-write tensor.
frozen_design.score: Primary ranking is the cross tensor Frobenius norm divided by the product-norm upper bound ||U^T Down||_F (||Left||_F ||Right W||_F + ||Right||_F ||Left W||_F). This is invariant to orthogonal writer/read gauges and uniform writer/read rescaling. Raw cross/self norms and complete unfolding spectra for the two positives are diagnostics only.
frozen_design.formula_check: For every head, compare the tensor contraction against direct finite M11 evaluation on one deterministic nonzero x,z pair; relative error must be at most 1e-5.

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_formula_finitenes: All authorities match; U8 is finite and column-orthonormal within 1e-5; every finite-substitution formula has relative error <=1e-5; all scores/spectra are finite; and the zero-forward price is exact.
predictions.pred_b_both_causal_writers_are_enriched_: L07H07 and L09H04 each rank in the top four of six candidates by normalized context-by-write score.
predictions.pred_c_causal_pair_has_a_weight_only_cap: The mean normalized context-by-write score of L07H07/L09H04 is at least 1.10 times the mean of the other four frozen candidates.
predictions.pred_d_scope_remains_diagnostic_and_open: The result preserves the prior causal set, selects no new head, rank, dose, or intervention, and is labeled as a weight-capability diagnostic.

null: A valid B or C failure means weight capability is too broad or too gauge-insensitive to shortlist these causal writers by itself. The next atlas must overlay frozen activation occupancy or use complete causal patches; it must not tune the capability normalization on this opened bank.
decision: If B and C pass, weight-only capability may prospectively prioritize the complete v21 writer atlas after H/R selects the writer branch, while every nominated edge still requires causal patching. If either fails, use capability only to describe possible computation and require occupancy before shortlisting.
